brief: Store a buffer length and write its trailing zero byte.
decl: void buffer_set_length(std::span<std::byte> buffer, std::uint32_t length, std::uint32_t &stored_length);
notes: Original thiscall: owner+8 receives length; the buffer pointer lives at owner+4.
The owner field and pointed buffer are separate host arguments. A truncated buffer is rejected before mutation.
